description: Apply a wallpaper pattern to a single wall side at (x,y,level). Side selects which wall face (0..5; 0-3 = the four cardinal segments on a square tile, 4-5 = the two diagonal sides). Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side gate; server-side also requires BuildBuyRoommate+ via Validator.CanBuildTool). Effect: wall TopLeftPattern / TopRightPattern at the targeted side flips to `pattern` — observable via query-architecture. Cost: wallpaper price per tile is debited from lot funds by Architecture.RunCommands. Denial silent (OQ-8). Wire: VMNetArchitectureCmd { Commands: [{ Type: PATTERN_DOT, level, x, y, x2=side, pattern }] }.
